patch_description:
This candidate refines the ansatz to improve generalization and sample efficiency by:
- Aligning multi-qubit motifs to tic-tac-toe winning geometries: shared ZZZ rotations for orthogonal rows/columns and shared doubly-controlled RZ (CCRZ) for the two diagonals. This encourages the circuit to directly capture triple-wise correlations relevant to the task.
- Splitting the trainable CRZ lattice into two semantic parameters: crz_perimeter (the 8 outer rim edges) and crz_spoke (the 4 center spokes). This gives the optimizer independent control over rim vs hub couplings while keeping gate count constant.
- Enforcing symmetry-aware parameter sharing (corner / edge / center) for local rotations (pre/post RZ and an RY mixing layer). This reduces the number of unique parameters per block, regularizes the model, and reduces overfitting risk.
- Keeping the ansatz compact (13 parameters per block, matching previous seeds) so the repeated re-upload/p> structure remains efficient while providing motif-aligned expressivity.

The result is a parameter-efficient, motif-targeted block expected to reduce train-test gap, lower L2 validation loss, and improve test accuracy in fewer Adam steps by focusing learning capacity on geometrically relevant interactions.
